items.criterion: A confirmed checkout writes one order whose eight figures are the brief's arithmetic, with a net of 1602 minor units on the worked case.
items.judgment: Read the order row for the confirmed purchase and compare every money column against the decomposition the brief pins.

items.criterion: The ledger entry for a paid order balances per currency, debiting provider receivable by the total and crediting the net to creator payable.
items.judgment: Sum the debit legs against the credit legs for the entry the order produced, then check each leg's account code.

items.criterion: The trial balance over every posting reads exactly zero minor units after a purchase settles.
items.judgment: Sum every posting as debits less credits and compare the result against zero.

items.criterion: Exactly one invoice for the order total exists in the billing platform after a paid checkout.
items.judgment: Read the tenant's invoice list for an invoice at the worked total, then check the app's own invoice row against it.

items.criterion: Two simultaneous confirms of the last unit of the limited product produce exactly one order between them.
items.judgment: Race two confirms from a shared barrier, then count the successful answers and the quantity sold.

items.criterion: A reader session is denied at every creator surface, with the protected state left unchanged.
items.judgment: Call each creator-only route with a reader token and read the status each one answers.

items.criterion: A reader-facing order response carries the subtotal, the discount, the tax and the total, with no creator-side figure among them.
items.judgment: Read the reader-facing order body and search for the four creator money field names.

items.criterion: A record belonging to another reader is answered as absent rather than as forbidden.
items.judgment: Ask for a second reader's order and entitlement with the first reader's token and read the status.

items.criterion: The pricing surface returns the same figures the order it describes carries, to the minor unit.
items.judgment: Read the pricing decomposition, confirm the matching order, then compare every money field between the two.

items.criterion: A replayed confirm carrying one idempotency key leaves exactly one order, one entitlement, one ledger entry and one invoice.
items.judgment: Confirm the same session twice with one key, then count each of the four record kinds.

items.criterion: Exactly one receipt reaches the buying reader, carrying the pinned subject prefix followed by the product name.
items.judgment: Poll the inbox for the buying reader's address and check the subject, the body and the absence of a copy to the other reader.

items.criterion: A discount code outside its window, or over its per-reader cap, is turned down with the session total left unchanged.
items.judgment: Apply the closed code, then re-read the session total, then apply the open code a second time as the same reader.

items.criterion: The served product page carries the product name, the tier code and the tier price before any script runs.
items.judgment: Read the public product response as text and search for each pinned value.

items.criterion: The console order detail lays the eight money figures out as separate labelled lines rather than as one total.
items.judgment: Open the console order detail as the creator and read the pane beside the order list.
